overall_safety_summary: The scene is generally organized, but the user is employing an unsafe hand position while slicing a small onion, presenting a risk of injury.

hazards.description: The user is slicing a small onion while stabilizing it with flat, extended fingers rather than a tucked claw grip.
hazards.explanation: This finger placement leaves the fingertips and knuckles highly exposed to the knife blade, increasing the risk of a painful cut if the knife slips.
hazards.older_adult_relevance: Older adults may experience reduced tactile sensitivity or hand tremors, making precise knife control more difficult and increasing the likelihood of injury from improper hand positioning.
hazards.recommended_action: Adopt a claw grip by curling the fingertips inward and resting the knuckles against the side of the blade to guide the cuts safely.

uncertainties: Whether the stove burner under the pan on the left is currently turned on or hot.
